reason: Classified as a navigation-focused UI plugin because it adds in-conversation controls to jump to the latest and previous user questions, integrates into the DeepSeek Harness web overlay area, and is explicitly scoped to chat history navigation rather than data generation, external automation, or backend integration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在聊天页面提供“最新问题/上一问题”跳转按钮，帮助用户在长对话中快速定位历史提问。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides Latest and Previous question navigation controls in chat, helping users jump through long conversation history quickly.

capabilities: injects a control in the DSH chat UI for navigating conversation questions
adds actions to jump to the latest user question and previous questions
tracks rendered conversation message anchors and paginated history to support backward navigation
auto-hides and resets at the conversation bottom to match existing navigation behavior
uses UI responsiveness for desktop and mobile presentation

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a lightweight navigation tool for DeepSeek Harness conversations with Latest/Previous question controls.
Package manifest marks it as a DSH web client plugin and injects into the UI layout package, indicating browser-based interface integration.
Compatibility notes reference chat DOM markers (e.g., data-conversation-scroll, data-chat-flow, user kind markers) and public overlay slot usage, showing targeted UI DOM-based navigation behavior.
